text: Under section 27 § 2 of the Prosecutors Act (Federal Law no. 2202-1 of 17 January 1992), if a prosecutor has grounds to suspect that a crime has been committed, he or she can take measures to ensure that the perpetrators are prosecuted in accordance with the law.

text: Under section 28 of the Prosecutors Act (Federal Law no. 2202-1 of 17 January 1992), a prosecutor or a deputy prosecutor may complain about acts violating individual rights to the competent authority which issued such an act or to the court.
